title: rubus tereticaulis subsp. subalpinus
intro: Rubus tereticaulis subsp. subalpinus, commonly known as the Korean raspberry, is a subspecies of the Rubus tereticaulis plant, a type of raspberry native to East Asia. The health benefits of this plant include its potential to improve cardiovascular health, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean raspberry include its use as a diuretic, to reduce fever, and to treat gastrointestinal issues. The bioactive constituents of Rubus tereticaulis subsp. subalpinus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
